summary: Chess Arena end-to-end validation. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passing (auth register/login/guest/me/profile, chess AI easy/medium/hard, hint, puzzles + daily + complete, games record + history, leaderboard sorted, online rooms create/join/legal-move/illegal-move/fools-mate/404). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home auto-authenticates as demo user 'ChessPlayer' rating 1225, PLAY COMPUTER launches MatchScreen, e2->e4 pawn move committed, AI black responded with a legal counter-move (Nf6 visible), HINT correctly returned 'Play Queen from D1 to F3 (Qf3)', UNDO reverted state, and all 5 bottom tabs (Home/Games/Puzzles/Profile/Settings) render correct content with 0 console errors. Deprecated packages detected: NONE. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE. Note: no testID attributes anywhere in frontend (see action items).

issues: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow' (appears twice on load). Non-blocking but should be addressed to future-proof.

action_items: Add testID attributes to all interactive elements (TouchableOpacity/Pressable/TextInput) across HomeScreen, AuthScreen, MatchScreen (board squares, Undo/Hint/Resign), BottomTabBar (each tab), ProfileScreen, SettingsScreen, PuzzlesScreen, LeaderboardScreen, OnlineModal. Currently zero testIDs — hurts automated regression testing and forces coordinate-based tapping.
Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow (React Native 0.76+ / react-native-web recommendation) to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional: expose EXPO_BACKEND_URL alias in frontend/.env (currently only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exists). Works today via EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefix, so no fix required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_profile/record_game/complete_puzzle fall back to user_demo_chessplayer when no auth token is provided — this means an unauthenticated client can mutate the demo account. Consider requiring a token or scoping writes to the caller only.

server.py init_db seeds bot users but if additional real users register the leaderboard_count check (<=2) prevents re-seeding, which is fine. However bots use hashed 'pass123' allowing anyone to log in as bot accounts. Consider disabling login for bot rows or randomizing their passwords.
server.py get_current_user_optional silently returns None on JWT decode error — expected for optional auth but consider a strict variant for /games/record and /auth/profile.
chess_engine.get_hint returns keys {from, to, san, description, eval} but no 'hint' wrapper; frontend must be aligned (verified working).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (home + match + AI move + hint + undo + 5 tabs)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds demo user chessplayer@gmail.com and 4 bot leaderboard players on startup. Tests created ~1 TEST_ prefixed user and 1 guest per run (not cleaned up — recommend TTL/cleanup fixture in future).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_chess_arena.py. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_chess_arena.py -n 0` because pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope and this file uses shared pytest-attr state across classes; -n 0 forces serial. All 21 tests pass on public preview URL. Frontend has NO testIDs — playwright had to click by text/coordinates. Board renders roughly x=20..370, y=150..515 in 390x844 mobile viewport (~44x45 per square).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. Two initial pytest failures during parallel run were caused by pytest-xdist splitting classes across workers, losing pytest-module-level state (pytest.demo_token). Solved by running with -n 0. No product bug.
